title: Customers and clients
intro: Whether you work in a shop in Dhaka, a call centre or a hotel in Dubai, customers judge you by how you speak. Learn to greet, help, handle complaints calmly and promise follow-up clearly.
introBn: দোকান, কল সেন্টার বা হোটেল যেখানেই কাজ করুন, গ্রাহক আপনার কথা বলার ধরন দেখে বিচার করেন। শুভেচ্ছা, সাহায্য, অভিযোগ সামলানো আর ফলো-আপ শিখুন।

units.title: Greeting and helping customers
units.idea: Good service English is short, warm and clear: greet, offer help, check what the customer needs, and confirm the next step.
units.ideaBn: ভালো সার্ভিসের ইংরেজি ছোট, আন্তরিক আর পরিষ্কার: শুভেচ্ছা দিন, সাহায্যের প্রস্তাব দিন, প্রয়োজনটা বুঝে নিন, পরের ধাপ নিশ্চিত করুন।

formula.name: Greet and offer
formula.pos: Good morning, how can I help you? · What can I do for you today?

formula.name: Check and confirm
formula.pos: Just to confirm, you'd like… · Is there anything else I can help you with?

formula.name: Upsell politely
formula.pos: Would you like to… as well? · You might also be interested in…

uses.rule: Offer help with 'How can I help you?' or 'What can I do for you?'
uses.bn: সাহায্যের প্রস্তাব দিতে How can I help you?
uses.ex: Good afternoon, welcome to Grameen Electronics. How can I help you?

uses.rule: Use 'Would you like…?' to offer, not 'Do you want…?'
uses.bn: অফার দিতে Would you like…? বেশি ভদ্র।
uses.ex: Would you like a bag for that?

uses.rule: Repeat the request to confirm it.
uses.ex: Just to confirm, you'd like two tickets for Saturday evening?

uses.rule: Upsell with a benefit, not pressure.
uses.ex: For 300 taka more, you get a two-year warranty. Would you like to add that?
Thanks for coming in. Have a great day!

traps.bn: 'What you want?' ভুল ও রূঢ়; How can I help you? বলুন।

traps.right: What seems to be the problem?
traps.why: An order sounds cold to a customer.
traps.bn: আদেশের মতো শোনায়; প্রশ্ন করে জানতে চান।

traps.wrong: Do you want to buy the warranty also?
traps.right: Would you like to add the warranty as well?
traps.why: 'Would you like' is polite; 'as well' sits naturally at the end.
traps.bn: Would you like… as well? বেশি স্বাভাবিক ও ভদ্র।

drills.q: A customer walks into the shop.
drills.s: Good morning! ___ can I help you?

o: You want a bag or not?
drills.x: Would you like…? is the polite offer.

drills.s: Just to ___, you'd like the blue one in a medium?

o: Is there anything else I can help you with?
Is there something other you need?
drills.a: Is there anything else I can help you with?

drills.q: Upselling at a phone shop in Dhaka.
drills.s: You might also be ___ in a screen protector.
drills.x: Be interested in (the person feels it).

drills.s: Thanks for ___. I'll be with you in a moment.

o: You must buy the bigger size.
For just 50 taka more, you can get the large size. Would you like that?
drills.a: For just 50 taka more, you can get the large size. Would you like that?

drills.s: Would you like me ___ a taxi for you?
drills.x: Would you like me to + base.

units.title: Complaints, bad news and follow-up
units.idea: When a customer is angry, stay calm: show you understand, apologise for the problem, say what you will do, and give a clear time. Promise only what you can keep.
units.ideaBn: রাগী গ্রাহকের সাথে শান্ত থাকুন: বুঝেছেন তা দেখান, সমস্যার জন্য দুঃখ প্রকাশ করুন, কী করবেন আর কখন করবেন তা বলুন।

formula.name: Empathise
formula.pos: I understand your frustration. · I'm sorry to hear that. · I can see why you're upset.

formula.name: Act
formula.pos: Let me look into it. · I'll check with our team right away.

formula.name: Promise
formula.pos: I'll get back to you by 3 pm. · You'll receive an update by Friday.

uses.ex: I understand your frustration. Let me see what happened.

uses.rule: Apologise for the problem, not with excuses.
uses.bn: অজুহাত নয়, সমস্যার জন্য দুঃখ প্রকাশ।
uses.ex: I'm sorry your order arrived late.

uses.rule: Give bad news with 'I'm afraid' or 'Unfortunately'.
uses.ex: I'm afraid that item is out of stock until next week.

uses.rule: Follow-up promise: will + by + a time.
uses.ex: I'll get back to you by tomorrow afternoon.

uses.rule: Offer a solution or a choice.
uses.ex: We can send a replacement or give you a full refund. Which would you prefer?

signals: I'll get back to you by

traps.wrong: I will get back to you until Monday.
traps.right: I'll get back to you by Monday.
traps.why: 'By' = no later than; 'until' = continuing up to.
traps.bn: শেষ সময় বোঝাতে by, until নয়।

traps.right: I completely understand, and I'm going to help you sort this out.
traps.bn: Calm down বললে গ্রাহক আরও রেগে যান।

traps.wrong: It is not our fault, it is courier's fault.
traps.right: I'm sorry about the delay. Let me check with the courier for you.
traps.why: Blaming others sounds defensive; also 'the courier'.

drills.q: A customer complains about a late delivery.

drills.s: Let me ___ into it and call you back.
I'll get back to you ___ 5 pm today.

drills.q: Pick the best response to an angry customer.
o: I understand your frustration. Let me check your order right now.
drills.a: I understand your frustration. Let me check your order right now.

drills.q: দুঃখিত, এই মডেলটা এখন স্টকে নেই।
o: I'm afraid this model is out of stock at the moment.
Sorry, this model is not in stock now days.
I'm afraid this model is finish.
drills.a: I'm afraid this model is out of stock at the moment.
drills.x: Out of stock; I'm afraid for bad news.

drills.s: We can repair it or replace it. Which would you ___?
___, we can't offer a refund after 30 days.

drills.q: Rafi emails an unhappy client. Pick the best line.
o: I will revert back you soon.
I'll get back to you by Thursday with an update.
I will reply you until Thursday.
drills.a: I'll get back to you by Thursday with an update.
drills.x: Get back to you + by + day.

drills.s: I'm afraid the flight ___ cancelled because of the weather.
drills.x: Present perfect passive for recent news.

mastery.q: Greeting a client on the phone.
mastery.s: Good afternoon, Rafi speaking. How ___ I help you?

mastery.q: Pick the calmest reply to a complaint.
o: I can see why you're upset. Let me sort this out for you.
mastery.a: I can see why you're upset. Let me sort this out for you.

mastery.s: I'll get ___ to you by Monday.
mastery.x: Get back to someone = reply later.

o: Let me look into it and get back to you.
I see the matter and inform you.
Let me look it and tell you back.
I am seeing and letting you know.
mastery.a: Let me look into it and get back to you.
mastery.x: Look into + get back to you.

mastery.s: Would you like to add a cover ___ well?
You'll receive the refund ___ the end of the week.
mastery.x: By the end of the week.
